test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows 1 and 2. A, B, C, D and E are sitting in row 1 facing the North and V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in row 2 facing the South, in such a way that each member in row 1 faces a member of row 2.

Neither A nor B sit at any of the extreme ends of the row. A sits second to the right of B. The one who faces B is an immediate neighbour of Z. Y sits second to the left of Z. The one who faces Y sits second to the left of C. W sits second to the right of V. D is not an immediate neighbour of A.

Who faces E?
solution:
Given:

Row 1: A, B, C, D and E facing the North.

Row 2: V, W, X, Y and Z facing the South.

1) Neither A nor B sit at any of the extreme ends of the row. A sits second to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b940edd3dc56a3ad73ced241822151ae433097ddf6be6f6c8c20d3ff9207071.png] 

2) The one who faces B is an immediate neighbour of Z.

3) Y sits second to the left of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/095c97af4485ae3c7232dff94d616e9ec13a69242fac877d8c40f3fbe4def06e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1393031b17ef44a1572709cbef31b8af91ec6b0b8234b42d2a86532f00c97420.png] 

 

4) The one who faces Y sits second to the left of C.

Case II is not possible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e26286f2f306381d8ae3a770bce1d0c6da9f68a9c8fcbb97cb3aa91fa8bcb25.png] 

5) W sits second to the right of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/851778f0c81a8176168bb047ae52962f05a112ff2be3189b455b0321a9fba430.png] 

6) D is not an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b3d0e95f1123986d3ff31e19e56e4a957f402169de36e7e119aa7f0ca4c998d.png] 

7) Final sitting arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/476540b93e4c457ee0a1b119fa34507dcb59ca3d084e9145b79c92ddc8ceba8c.png] 

Hence, "Y" **faces E.**
